preview: Aryan Khurana shares his interview experience for an internship at Wells Fargo, detailing the online assessment, technical rounds, and HR interviews.
content:
Wells Fargo Interview Experience
Aryan Khurana | TY BTech CE
Coding Round:
There were 3 sections in the online exam.
Section 1 was basically general vocabulary,reading passages.This section was pretty
easy.I was able to solve all the questions.Most of them were probably correct.
Section 2 consisted of some questions related to stocks,airline tickets,finance etc based
on a passage.One needs to have strong data analysis and interpretation skills for this
section.This section was pretty long and I couldn’t solve all the questions here.So I
randomly guessed the questions I couldn’t answer as there was no negative marking
here.
Section 3 was the main coding round.It had 2 questions.This round didn’t go well for
me.I was able to pass 12/17 test cases in one question and only 3/20 in the other
question.
1.In the first question we had to arrange an array into groups of 3 like (a,b,c) wherein
b/a==c/b.We had to print all such groups.I tried brute force approach but couldn’t pass
any test cases.Then I tried a map based approach but could only pass 3 test cases
here.I was really disappointed as I had wasted a lot of time on this question.
2.The second question was pretty doable but I wasted a lot of time on the first question
so could pass 12/17 tcs here.I don’t really remember the question but it was based on
priority queues.
Then came the result.31 students were shortlisted for the next round.I was really not
expecting that I would qualify.But I did qualify!I was really shocked and amazed.
Round 2:
This round once again came as a shock to me!I was asked no dsa question in this
round.It was mostly resume based.The interviewer asked me about the subjects I had in
college.Then he asked me about my recent project and asked me to explain it.He also
asked about the target audience of the project.Since my project was based on
python,he asked me to retrieve data from an excel file and store it.Then he asked me to
write a stored procedure give some condition.After this he asked about the 4 pillars  of
OOPS.He asked me to explain all of them in detail taking real life examples.He also
asked me about the disadvantages of inheritance.I was asked to write pseudo code for
hierarchical inheritance.This was all he asked me.
This round went pretty well and I got shortlisted for the next round alongwith 16 other
students!
Round 3:
This was a tech+hr round.
I was asked to introduce myself.He asked me about my hobbies,what I would do in case
of conflict of interests etc and some standard hr questions.
Then he asked me about multithreading and asked me to explain it using python.He
asked me to explain one of my machine learning projects in detail(Fake news
classifier).He asked me about the data I used,data preprocessing.Then he asked me
some theoretical questions related to data structures.He asked me to explain stack with
a real world use.Some standard questions on OOPS,DSA and OS were asked as well.
This round went well.
And finally I got selected after this round alongwith 5 other students!
After this there was an hr round that took place on phone and it was a mere formality.
Tips:
1)First of all,for internships do have some projects based on any technology mentioned
in your resume and be prepared for indepth questions on the same.
2)Most importantly,focus on DBMS,OOPS,OS and DSA.If you have some time ,you can
study basics of CN.For our batch CN was in 5th semester so we always had the excuse
of it not being taught yet ready XD.
3)If you are studying DSA,do study about the practical application for each DS.
4)Also do start studying for these internships at least as soon as your 4th sem gets over.
5)Have faith on your studies and prep.In campus intern drives, a lot depends on luck as
well!Never doubt yourself and keep studying.
6)For DP,problems on Binary search,sliding window I watched Aditya Verma’s playlist.I
practiced DSA questions on gfg.Also,in order to actually understand the way of
presenting a dsa question to the interviewer , I watched DSA videos by
takeuforward(Striver) as well.For DSA,450 problems by Love Babbar or the SDE sheet
by Striver is op!If you want to learn the fundamentals of DSA then watch vidoes by
mycodeschool.
7)For OOPS,learn about UML and all you studied in your FY.For vtables and vpointers
this video by Keerti Puserwani is gold:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=47ZP-0iBicI
8)For DBMS,I watched Sanchit Jain’s playlist and referred these notes by Apna college
for
revision:https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KV-9I5D6iddJbAoDzPEBVR6izf-j_7PXq3
JQSC7KC2Q/edit
9)For OS,I watched Gate smasherss’ playlist and referred notes by Apna college for
quick
revision:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1B_kmekdghu-sO8-eXZ1kc4Xx_YtB8BPM/view
10)Do be prepared for detailed questions on you resume.
11)Also , do not be dejected if you are not selected for any company!There is always a
next one.Just give your best,work hard and let destiny decide the rest of it!:)
12)If you feel stressed out,do some meditation and never forget that you should work
hard without fearing for the result!
13)Just stay calm and cool during interviews and refer interview bit for common hr
questions.
https://www.interviewbit.com/hr-interview-questions/
14)Have confidence on yourself!Best of Luck!Phodke aana:)
